greeting.text: You are going up there. Good. I was sent up this mountain to stop that thing and it has had me pinned on this ledge since dawn. My name is Bram. I serve the king in Tolmere, and the Red Fleet has been over my city since dawn, so I will fight beside you and then I would like to go home, if you are going that way.

joins.text: Good. I will take the left. Do not let it get above you; it is worse when it is above you.

rest.text: I have rested for six hours under a beam. Ask me again.

with_you.text: Whatever is in front of us, I will be in front of it first. That is what I am for.
